scheme_name: Co-Working Space/ Incubators/ Accelerators Subsidy Scheme
other_conditions: Startup must be certified by the Startup Promotion Cell (SPC).
Bank account of the startup must be linked to Aadhaar.
Payments to co‑working spaces, incubators or accelerators must be made digitally, unless SPC decides otherwise.
benefits_summary: Startups receive reimbursement of up to 50 % of seat costs (capped at ₹3000 for co‑working spaces, ₹5000 for incubators, ₹6000 for accelerators) for up to 8 seats, with duration limits of two years, one year and three months respectively.
